title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
keyIdea: Three states per day: hold (own a share), sold (sold today), rest (no share, free to buy). sold = hold + price; hold = max(hold, rest − price); rest = max(rest, yesterday's sold). Buying only from rest enforces the one-day cooldown. Answer max(sold, rest).

approaches.name: State machine (hold / sold / rest)
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). Update the three states each day using yesterday's values; hold starts at −∞.

quiz.q: Why can hold only come from rest (not sold)?
options: Right after selling there is a cooldown day; buying from sold would skip it
rest needs yesterday's sold, but sold is overwritten first
max(sold, rest): ending without a share is always better
